def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    special = [(r, c, v) for r in range(h) for c, v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v not in (0, background)]
    frame = Counter(v for _, _, v in special).most_common(1)[0][0]
    center = next(v for _, _, v in special if v != frame)
    rs = [r for r, _, _ in special]
    cs = [c for _, c, _ in special]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
    out = [[background] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            out[r][c] = frame if r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1) else center
    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks = [(r, c, v) for r in range(h) for c, v in enumerate(grid[r])
             if v not in (0, background)]
    outer = Counter(v for _, _, v in marks).most_common(1)[0][0]
    inner_values = [v for _, _, v in marks if v != outer]
    inner = inner_values[0] if inner_values else 0
    top = min(r for r, _, _ in marks)
    bottom = max(r for r, _, _ in marks)
    left = min(c for _, c, _ in marks)
    right = max(c for _, c, _ in marks)
    result = [[background] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
        for c in range(left, right + 1):
            result[r][c] = outer
    center_r = (top + bottom) // 2
    center_c = (left + right) // 2
    for r in (center_r - 1, center_r):
        for c in (center_c - 1, center_c):
            result[r][c] = inner
    return result
